cues.t: I'm already up, high intensity interval training on the treadmill, catching up on my podcasts.
Email, but not before I read my blogs, and journal about creativity.
Order the pour-over, wink at the barista.
The Q's running late, so I hop on the 7-9 and do a back-around at the transfer stop on 96th and Fullerton.
I'm walking to the office when I get a notif.
Insta. My favorite celeb just went live.
Do I risk being late or give up a chance to finally be noticed?
Not a prob, load the vid, post the perfect chat message.
Gotta install the latest security patches to stay compliant with corporate policy?
Check the Robinhood while I’m waiting.
All red. Just what I thought.
I'm already on Twitter with a hot take.
Sit alone. No time for idle chatter.
A moleskine and writing positive affirmations is all I need.
Time to call it a day.
Not bad. But I'll have better.
City lights have my circadian rhythm screwed up.
Gotta head home before it gets too bad.
One chapter of Marcus Aurelius' Meditations on the Nook.
Tweet a quote just as the battery dies for the day.
Time for phase one of my polyphasic sleep cycle.
Tomorrow’s day 1 of my intermittent fasting routine.
